title: Crossbows

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Crossbows is a weapon class.
Crossbows shoot equipped bolts and cannot be retrieved. Loading itself takes 3.5 seconds and uses 4 stamina, however, with the firing, loading, and readying animations, it can only be fired every 6 seconds.
Jumping and sprinting resets the loading progress, and bolts cannot be loaded while sprinting. After the crossbow is loaded, it can be fired at any time at no stamina cost. After firing, another bolt will need to be loaded. The bolts do not stay loaded when switching to other weapons, so a bolt is loaded whenever the item is equipped.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Like bows, the player can block with a crossbow, but this interrupts and halts the loading animation.
• Damage does not scale like a bow. Only leveling the skill will increase the damage.

full_text:
Crossbows

Introduction. Crossbows is a weapon class.
Crossbows shoot equipped bolts and cannot be retrieved. Loading itself takes 3.5 seconds and uses 4 stamina, however, with the firing, loading, and readying animations, it can only be fired every 6 seconds.
Jumping and sprinting resets the loading progress, and bolts cannot be loaded while sprinting. After the crossbow is loaded, it can be fired at any time at no stamina cost. After firing, another bolt will need to be loaded. The bolts do not stay loaded when switching to other weapons, so a bolt is loaded whenever the item is equipped.

Notes. • Like bows, the player can block with a crossbow, but this interrupts and halts the loading animation.
• Damage does not scale like a bow. Only leveling the skill will increase the damage.
